-- Quest #141 / Scene #1 - Function Alsmeer_Donjuan_Talk01
function Alsmeer_Donjuan_Talk01()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town002D.fld")
	MoveCamera(0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	RotCamera(0.00, 1.57, 100.00)

	CreateObject(0, 10053, 821.00, 1208.00, 0, 0, TRUE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(1, 1478, 826.00, 1153.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 1, 1)
	CreateObject(2, 1479, 821.00, 1148.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 1, 10)
	CreateObject(3, 1480, 826.00, 1143.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 1, 19)
	CreateObject(4, 1481, 816.00, 1153.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 1, 28)
	CreateObject(5, 1482, 816.00, 1143.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 1, 37)
	CreateObject(6, 10005, 821.00, 1103.00, 128, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayMusic("BGM038.ogg")
	PlayCamera("Alsmeer_Donjuan_Talk_01.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(21, 1)
	PlayCameraNoWait("Alsmeer_Donjuan_Talk_02.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	ShowObject(0, 1)
	WalkObject(6, 821.000000, 1133.000000, 52.340000, 1, 4, 4)
	wait(3000)
	OpenTalkScene(21, 2)
	RotateObject(6, 0, 0)
	OpenTalkScene(21, 3)
	PlayCameraNoWait("Alsmeer_Donjuan_Talk_03.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	WalkObject(6, 821.000000, 1103.000000, 52.340000, 1, 4, 4)
	wait(1000)
	WalkObject(0, 821.000000, 1163.000000, 52.340000, 1, 5, 0)
	wait(1000)
	RotateObject(1, 128, 1)
	RotateObject(4, 128, 1)
	wait(1000)
	RotateObject(2, 128, 1)
	RotateObject(3, 128, 1)
	RotateObject(5, 128, 1)
	OpenTalkScene(21, 4)
	PlayCameraNoWait("Alsmeer_Donjuan_Talk_04.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
